Below is a compiled list of popular office furniture brands and their official websites. These brands are known for their high-quality office furniture, ranging from ergonomic chairs and standing desks to modular workstations and more:

---

### **Well-Known Office Furniture Brands**
---

1. **Herman Miller**  
   Website: [www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)

2. **Steelcase**  
   Website: [www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)

3. **Knoll**  
   Website: [www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)

4. **Haworth**  
   Website: [www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)

5. **Humanscale**  
   Website: [www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)

6. **IKEA**  
   Website: [www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com)  
   (*Note: IKEA offers affordable, modern office furniture.*)

7. **HON**  
   Website: [www.hon.com](https://www.hon.com)

8. **VARIDESK (Vari)**  
   Website: [www.vari.com](https://www.vari.com)  
   (*Famous for its standing desks and ergonomic solutions.*)

9. **Autonomous**  
   Website: [www.autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)

10. **Branch Furniture**  
    Website: [www.branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com)

11. **Flexispot**  
    Website: [www.flexispot.com](https://www.flexispot.com)  
    (*Specializes in height-adjustable desks and ergonomic accessories.*)

12. **Steelcase (AMQ Solutions)**  
    Website: [www.amqsolutions.com](https://www.amqsolutions.com)

13. **HNI Corporation**  
    Website: [www.hnicorp.com](https://www.hnicorp.com)  
    (*Parent Company of HON and other brands.*)

14. **Poppin**  
    Website: [www.poppin.com](https://www.poppin.com)  
    (*Offers colorful, modern office furniture and supplies.*)

15. **Ergotron**  
    Website: [www.ergotron.com](https://www.ergotron.com)  
    (*Specializes in ergonomic workspace solutions.*)

16. **Global Furniture Group**  
    Website: [www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)

17. **HBF (Hickory Business Furniture)**  
    Website: [www.hbf.com](https://www.hbf.com)

18. **SitOnIt Seating**  
    Website: [www.sitonit.net](https://www.sitonit.net)  
    (*Offers customizable and ergonomic office seating.*)

19. **Wayfair Professional (Office Furniture)**  
    Website: [www.wayfair.com/professional](https://www.wayfair.com/professional)  
    (*Affordable office furniture solutions for businesses.*)

20. **Kimball International**  
    Website: [www.kimballinternational.com](https://www.kimballinternational.com)  
    (*Specializes in workplace and hospitality furniture.*)

21. **Teknion**  
    Website: [www.teknion.com](https://www.teknion.com)

22. **Buro**  
    Website: [www.buroseating.com](https://www.buroseating.com)  
    (*Specializes in high-quality office seating solutions.*)

23. **Safco Products**  
    Website: [www.safcoproducts.com](https://www.safcoproducts.com)

24. **NeueChair/Sekretlab (Ergonomic Chairs)**  
    Website: [www.secrelab.co/neuechair](https://www.secretlab.co/neuechair)

25. **TopSky**  
    Website: [www.topsyk.com](https://www.topsyk.com)  
---
  
### Tips for Choosing Office Furniture  

- **Ergonomics First:** Always prioritize ergonomic chairs, desks, and monitors to ensure employee comfort and health.  
- **Modularity:** Consider modular furniture for growing businesses, as it offers flexibility.  
- **Durability:** Invest in durable pieces if long-term use is a priority, even if the price might be higher.  
- **Budget:** Big corporations like Herman Miller and Steelcase offer premium options but check budget-friendly alternatives like IKEA, Wayfair, or Flexispot.
